prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE actual neutral source key drawing for a three-combat-attribute combination in a 2D game.
Input image 1: the approved TWO-ATTRIBUTE comparison sheet for this species, as identity and coherent anatomical integration reference. Input image 2: approved SINGLE-ATTRIBUTE atlas, as the exact material and functional shape vocabulary. Both are supporting references, NOT output layouts.
Create exactly ONE complete character combining ONLY the three selected attributes. Make the same species look as if these functions naturally fit in one body. Design shared roots, joints, tissue/mineral transitions, proportions and silhouette TOGETHER. One dominant integrated structure; subordinate functions should appear in its surfaces, rim or junctions. Keep broad quiet areas and readable original body. Do not simply pile three complete accessories together or add the other two attributes.
One neutral ready pose, mostly frontal with slight rightward orientation; match the approved painterly casual-game sprite style, camera, dark thin clean contour, soft upper-left lighting, face and materials. Complete subject centered inside a square canvas with generous 10 percent transparent padding. Exactly TWO eyes, mouthless. Genuine transparent background. No text, labels, diagrams, ground, shadows, effects, detached particles, extra poses or characters. No costume, straps, held equipment, metal hardware, realistic anatomy, 3D toy rendering, pixel art or excessive surface noise.
This is actual source artwork for later production after review. Draw complete closed surfaces and clean connections.

SPECIES: Warm ochre-beige rounded gently faceted pebble creature, exactly two dark bead eyes, no mouth, two tiny tan stone feet. Matte ochre parent rock and open face remain the dominant volume. Precious translucent minerals grow from visible natural seams.Use ONE intergrown shoulder/back formation with restrained role colors, not a necklace around the face.
SELECTED ATTRIBUTES ONLY: blade + carapace + guard (칼날 + 갑피 + 엄호).
INTEGRATED CONSTRUCTION: Low sapphire plates form a compact protective crust over the upper back (carapace). This SAME crust broadens on the right into one rose-quartz buttress (guard), whose exposed outer cleavage has a restrained emerald-green cutting margin (blade). Resolve all facets into one intergrown layer, no ring around face, no separate point or amber pores.
